description: Release-number and public-figure inventory. Current instructions follow source versions. scan.discovery_contract: SemVer-shaped tokens and the public count/percentage phrases recognized by release_doc_versions.py must be registered in these roots. This is bounded lexical discovery, not arbitrary natural-language claim verification. Source code, configuration defaults, schema versions, asset geometry and raw benchmark tables are outside lexical discovery; historical benchmark files are content-pinned below. CHANGELOG history is retained; its newest numbered heading is checked directly. Third-party action, toolchain and dependency pins in workflows and action.yml are owned by Renovate and are not release numbers of this product; workflow and action product installation pins are checked by the product-version recognizers, and reusable-scan.yml product examples are registered with contextual selectors.
